content: P2 (MEASURED, sha512): rewrite serial N-operand add chains as balanced binary adder trees (mod-2^w addition is associative -> provably equivalent). sha512: WNS -97->+235ps, area -0.6%, gate 24/24. Expose sub-terms as wires.

P2b: for 3+ operand adds, use carry-save (3:2 compressor) tree -> single final carry-propagate adder; shorter than balanced CPA tree. Higher rewrite risk; keep operand order documented and let the gate catch errors.

P1 (MEASURED, async_fifo): registered gray pointer equals gray(registered binary); replace duplicate gray register with combinational bin>>1 ^ bin. +13ps slack but +0.86% area (FF removal added comb cells). CDC-safe (single-bit change property preserved).
P4: share redundant +/-1 lookahead incrementers (e.g. async_fifo computes gray(next) AND gray(next+1) with two adders; derive the second from the first).

P5: VT/CORNER/ABC_AREA knobs exist but env.sh clobbers CLI values during synth while STA uses caller values -> inconsistent libs. Only use knobs via workspace-patched env; keep RVT/TT/speed for scored runs until organizer clarifies legality.
High-fanout control signal on critical path -> replicate the driver register/logic per consumer group (signal replication / fanout management).
Deep FSM/decode condition feeding datapath -> pre-compute the condition one cycle earlier into a register when a spare cycle exists (condition pre-computation). CHECK TB latency tolerance first.
Wide equality/magnitude compare on critical path -> restructure: split into ranges, early-out constant bits, or one-hot re-encode the compared state.
Mux-heavy selection tree -> re-balance select logic, convert priority chains to parallel one-hot selects, or insert a register on the select path (selective register insertion; latency check needed).
Wide flat casez/priority encoder -> two-level hierarchy: 4-bit group valid bits + per-group encode (log depth). C910 LZA case: -40% delay, -32% area.
Declare named intermediate wires with explicit widths at logical boundaries — helps Yosys/ABC partition and optimize independently (RTLScout lesson).
Barrel shifters have overhead; for small index ranges (<=~11) an explicit mux chain is cheaper (RTLScout).

Arithmetic architecture menu for critical-path * and +: partial products via carry-save/Wallace/Dadda/4:2-compressor tree; final adder Kogge-Stone / Brent-Kung / Sklansky / sparse-KS. Propose ONE alternative per candidate.
Area levers: logic simplification/CSE, FSM re-encoding (binary vs one-hot by state count), resource sharing of mutually-exclusive adders/multipliers, operator strength reduction (x*2^k -> shift).

Power levers: operand isolation (gate inputs of unused units), clock gating via enable registers, minimize shifting register banks (pointer-addressed window instead of physical shift). Power numbers are noisy without activity data — trust only large deltas.

Large physically-shifting register file (e.g. sha512 w_mem 16x64 shifts 1024 FF/cycle) -> circular buffer with pointer-addressed reads; cuts FF clock activity and mux area. Medium risk: index arithmetic must be exact.
AVOID re-balancing logic ABC already optimizes well (absorbed by synthesis, adds churn/risk for ~0 gain) — e.g. simple 2-3 operand expressions (Dr. RTL AVOID).
AVOID moving control-signal updates across register boundaries — top equivalence-breaker class in Dr. RTL (SEC failures).
AVOID chasing FF count: in ASAP7 FFs are cheap; removing FFs by adding comb+buffers can INCREASE area (L1, measured in exp1).
AVOID restructuring 2-FF synchronizers or gray-code CDC pointer logic beyond proven P1; every published method scored ZERO on async_fifo by breaking this (Alpha-RTL Table 4).

P2 applicability (MEASURED, exp3): source-level balancing of a PURE N-operand sum (e.g. w_new = a+b+c+d) is a no-op — ABC's delay-aware mapping already rebalances clean sums (identical netlist). P2 pays when serial adds are ENTANGLED with nonlinear logic between terms (Ch/Maj/sigma in exp2: +332ps). Target entangled chains only.

AVOID source-level mux/late-signal-isolation hints (MEASURED, ascon exp4): rewriting a 4-way `unique case` writeback into early-resolve + a single 2:1 on the late round signal is ABSORBED by ABC's timing-driven mapping — proxy depth unchanged (83->83), setup -430->-443, +101 cells from the duplicated select compare. Corollary to p2-pure-sum-noop: ABC recovers LOCAL restructuring (mux balance, pure-sum assoc). Only GLOBAL algebraic changes ABC can't reverse survive (exp2 entangled adder tree; GF-basis swaps).

P24 (MEASURED, async_fifo exp5, LEC-PROVEN): mux-of-gray formulation (share gray(bin+1) across full/almost-full paths, reuse registered gray pointer for the hold case) trades area for slack: +7.2ps setup, +3.7% cells, +3.7% power. REJECT when timing already MET (area regression); APPLY when an async-FIFO pointer/flag path is timing-critical.

P25 (MEASURED, kmac exp7): flattening the Bivium/Trivium 800-step serial key-stream unroll into generation-chunked data-parallel stages (algorithmically equivalent — proven in a Python golden model over random states) did NOT improve timing: setup -1115.75->-1119.68ps, cells +0.7%. Synthesis/ABC already retimes the serial composition. AVOID manual PRNG-unroll restructuring; the kmac critical path is not helped by it. (Note: kmac generated RTL fails iverilog elaboration on a pre-existing sv2v artifact -> use LEC/dualsim gating, differential compile.)
(prim, agent) AVOID manual logic restructuring in simple primitives as it can interfere with synthesis heuristics and degrade timing.
(prim, agent) Ensure manual micro-optimizations like intermediate wire insertion maintain strict bit-width consistency to avoid synthesis elaboration failures.
(prim, agent) Avoid micro-optimizations on logic structures that synthesis tools already optimize to their limit, as they result in zero PPA change.

Wide carry-propagate add on the critical path -> parallel-prefix adder (Kogge-Stone / Brent-Kung / Sklansky): O(log n) carry depth vs O(n) ripple. Equivalence-safe (same sum). Trade area (KS) vs wires (BK).
Multiplier on critical path -> radix-4 Booth encoding halves partial-product rows, then Wallace/Dadda reduce + one final prefix add. Equivalence-safe.
Multiply/divide by a COMPILE-TIME CONSTANT -> shift-and-add / shift-and-mask (x*9 = (x<<3)+x; x/2^k = x>>k; x%2^k = x&(2^k-1)). Removes the multiplier.

Repeated subexpressions across the cone -> algebraic factoring / distributivity (a*b + a*c -> a*(b+c); Horner form for polynomials). e-graph-verified rewrites (ROVER/ASPEN); shortens depth AND shares logic.

Constant-driven operators -> fold and propagate (identity: x&1'b1, x|1'b0, x^1'b0; dead branches on tied selects). Yosys opt does some, but explicit RTL folding exposes more and shrinks the cone the model reasons over.
Internal datapath wider than needed -> narrow provably-unused MSBs (range analysis on accumulators/counters). Fewer cells + shorter carry.

Datapath whose result is muxed away when idle -> operand isolation: AND the datapath inputs with a valid/enable so they don't toggle when unused. Cuts dynamic power; equivalence-safe (output already ignored).

Register bank with an update-enable expressed as a feedback mux (q <= en ? d : q) -> let synthesis infer a clock gate (or code an ICG). Cuts clock + register dynamic power on wide, infrequently-updated regs.
Wide equality/magnitude compare on the path -> XOR-reduce tree for ==, parallel-prefix for < / >, and early-out on constant bits. Log depth.
Priority if/else or casez chain feeding a datapath when the conditions are mutually exclusive -> parallel one-hot select (AND-OR), removing the serial priority ladder. Verify mutual exclusion holds.

LATENCY-GATED: if (and only if) the TB tolerates latency changes, balance unequal pipeline stages by retiming registers across combinational logic (move a register from a short stage into a long one). Otherwise DO NOT - our equivalence gate rejects cycle-latency changes.
